howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three integrated apps, one seamless logistics ecosystem

freightOwner.title: Freight Owner
freightOwner.step1Desc: Get the Ethiochinet Freight Owner App from App Store or Google Play.
freightOwner.step2Desc: Create your account and register your freight requirements.
freightOwner.step3Desc: Review and sign a digital agreement to authorize transport.
freightOwner.step4Desc: Authorize transport commencement and track your freight in real-time.
freightOwner.step5Desc: Receive your freight and confirm delivery upon completion.

driver.title: Driver
driver.step1Desc: Get the Ethiochinet Driver App from App Store or Google Play.
driver.step2Desc: Add funds to your digital wallet to participate in the platform.
driver.step3Desc: Accept freight orders and enter into a digital agreement.
driver.step4Desc: Proceed to the pickup location, load freight, and begin transport.
driver.step5Desc: Deliver the freight, confirm completion, and receive payment.

vehicleOwner.title: Vehicle Owner
vehicleOwner.step1Desc: Get the Ethiochinet Vehicle Owner App from App Store or Google Play.
vehicleOwner.step2Desc: Register your vehicle information including plate number and details.
vehicleOwner.step3Desc: Assign a qualified driver to operate your registered vehicle.
vehicleOwner.step4Desc: Track orders, agreements, and deliveries linked to each vehicle.
vehicleOwner.step5Desc: Monitor all activity per vehicle by plate number in real-time.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To revolutionize Ethiopia's logistics sector by creating a seamless digital platform that connects freight owners with reliable drivers, making transportation efficient, transparent, and accessible to all.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To become Ethiopia's most trusted digital logistics platform, empowering businesses and drivers while contributing to the growth of the nation's economy through innovative technology solutions.

story.title: Our Story
story.description: Ethiochinet was born from a simple observation: Ethiopia's logistics sector was fragmented, inefficient, and lacked transparency. In 2023, our founding team came together to bridge this gap.
